feeds.title: Melanie Wilks Blog
feeds.description: Melanie Wilks, based in Dewsbury West Yorkshire is a sculptor and artist who specialises in stone carving. Read the blog to find articles on carving of stone.

feeds.title: Jennifer Tetlow Blog
feeds.description: I began carving stone after a chance encounter with masons dressing wall-stones, and was taken by the sound and rhythm of hammer on chisel, and the neat-handed skills of the quarry men at work. On the strength of this meeting I purchased my first stone working tools and my love affair with stone began. A love of wildlife and the natural world is at the core of my work, enthusing and driving a desire to capture a creature essence in simple shape and form.

feeds.title: Simon Burns-Cox
feeds.description: Simon Burns-Cox is a Sculptor and Letter Carver based at The Edinburgh Sculpture Workshop. He works mainly in Stone and Marble and creates Interior and Exterior Garden Sculptures, Gravestones, Memorials and Headstones. He also offers all types of Stone Letter Carving for Home and Business.

feeds.title: Graeme Mitcheson Stone Sculptor
feeds.description: Graeme Mitcheson has been creating stone sculpture since graduating from Loughborough College of Art in 1995. Images of Graeme's work can be found in the gallery while details of Graeme's current projects as well as upcoming dates for stone carving courses and exhibitions can be found on his blog.
